en.headline: Police arrest Citybus driver after pedestrian dies in North Point
en.dek: A man was struck by a Citybus at about 8am on King's Road near Tin Chong Street; he was pronounced dead at Eastern Hospital at 8.54am and the driver has been arrested.
body: Police have arrested the driver of a Citybus after a pedestrian died following a collision in North Point on Monday morning.

Officers received a report at about 8am that a Citybus travelling east along King's Road had struck a male pedestrian at the junction with Tin Chong Street. The man suffered severe head and body injuries and was unconscious when taken to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital, where he was pronounced dead at 8.54am.

The driver was arrested following the incident. Police are investigating the circumstances, including vehicle movements and available camera footage. Some lanes were temporarily closed but have since reopened.

zh.headline: 北角城巴撞倒途人致死 司機被捕
zh.dek: 今早約8時，一名男子在北角英皇道近電廠街遭城巴撞倒，送東區醫院後於8時54分證實死亡，城巴司機已被捕。
body: 警方已拘捕涉事城巴司機，事緣今早北角發生交通意外，一名途人被撞後不治。
警方約於早上8時接報，一輛沿英皇道東行的城巴在近電廠街交界處撞倒一名男途人。男子頭部及身體嚴重受傷，送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院時已昏迷，並於8時54分證實死亡。
司機其後被拘捕。警方正調查意外情況，包括車輛動向及閉路電視片段。部分行車線一度封閉，現已重開。
